skill_scope_check.name: skill_scope_check
skill_scope_check.value:
("skills"."scope" = 'company' AND "skills"."department_id" IS NULL AND "skills"."owner_employee_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("skills"."scope" = 'department' AND "skills"."department_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("skills"."scope" = 'personal' AND "skills"."owner_employee_id" IS NOT NULL)
